text: RACE: CHILDREN_LOADED/FAILED do not check which request they answer — a stale listing arriving after INVALIDATE_DIRECTORIES + refetch is stored again. The controller must tag requests (token per path) and drop stale responses. Add a test: invalidate+refetch, then the OLD response resolves last → cache keeps the NEW listing.

RACE: NAVIGATE_COMMITTED/FAILED do not check path === pendingRoot and SET_ROOT does not clear pendingRoot — a late commit can move the root back. Controller must ignore commits whose path is not the current pendingRoot. Test: goUp twice quickly / setRoot during pending → final root is the last intent.

Normalize root keys (trailing separator, '/' vs '\' on Windows) before cache lookup; UI must check canGoUp before NAVIGATE_UP (at a drive root parentPathOf returns the root itself). Prune selection on root change/invalidation.

fileTreeState.ts, fileExplorerClipboard.ts, fileExplorerContextMenu.ts must NOT reference viewableExtensions / isViewableExtension / isOpenableFile (FR-FEX-011 AC-7 guard in fileRowInteraction.test.ts stays red until both files exist).

rowRenderClass decides the cut class by path only (rows carry no sessionId): with clipboard entries from several sessions, a same-path row in another session is dimmed. Pass the explorer tab sessionId into the cut check.

validator C25: green tasks carry green_evidence but no red_evidence (the red evidence lives on the paired red task). Before final validation copy the paired red task red_evidence into each green task (fx-step2 and fx-step3).

decideOpenFileExplorer returns create when the dialogId is not registered. A minimized explorer window must stay mounted (design decision 20: minimize does not unmount) or be tracked by the workspace window record; otherwise opening it again re-creates the window and overwrites its tabs. The hook must look up the workspace window record first, clear minimized and raiseDialogById(id, modeless). Add a guard/test.
resolveSession(originTabId) must fall back to the workspace active terminal tab when the origin tab is gone (not unit-tested in T-PH002-03). Add a wiring case.

note: CSS contract: exact 5 TSX names; FileExplorer.css; only var(--token) colors (also in JSX style/fill/stroke); every var declared in tokens.css or same file; single .fx-row[aria-selected="true"] rule with background var(--bg-active) + border-left-color var(--sel-bar), base .fx-row border-left:2px solid transparent; .fx-row{height:var(--row-h)} no numeric heights; radii var(--r-*)/0/calc(var(--r-*)); no CSS nesting; no surface/dataSurface identifiers, no 'data-surface' strings, no 'chrome'/'paper' strings except JSX data-surface value; window root never paper; rows className fx-row + aria-selected.

Hook: const explorer = useFileExplorerWindows({ workspaces: wm.workspaces, tabs: wm.tabs, resolveTabSession, screen, activeWorkspaceId: wm.activeWorkspaceId }); returns memoized {windows, openFileExplorer({workspaceId, originTabId}), closeFileExplorer, minimizeFileExplorer, selectTab, closeTab, addTab, setTabRoot, setTabMode, setTabSort, setTabAnchor}. Mount {explorer.windows.map(w => <FileExplorerWindow key={w.workspaceId} workspaceId tabs activeTabId hidden actions={explorer} onOpenFile={editor.openDocument}/>)} inside TerminalRuntimeProvider next to EditorWindowLayer. onOpenFile(filePath, tabId=originTabId). Pass stable fn. openFileExplorer is open-or-raise, does not switch workspace. Remaining red: FR-FEX-010 AC5-01 (Header button aria-label 파일 탐색기 -> onOpenFileExplorer), AC6-02 (App wiring).

fileExplorerClipboard.ts: ExplorerClipboard {mode:'copy'|'cut'; entries:{sessionId,path}[]} (same shape as fileRowInteraction ExplorerClipboard); get()->same ref until change; set(v); clear(); subscribe(l)->unsub; copySelection/cutSelection({sessionId,paths}) drop exact '..' last segment (both separators), keep '..hidden', replace not merge, return stored; buildPasteJobRequest(cb,{destSessionId,destPath})->{operation copy|move, sourceSessionId: entries[0].sessionId, sources, destSessionId, destPath}; buildDeleteJobRequest({sessionId,paths})->{operation:'delete',sourceSessionId,sources}|null. fileExplorerShortcuts.ts: decideFileExplorerShortcut({event:{key,ctrlKey,metaKey,altKey?,repeat?},focusedInSurface,selectionCount})->{kind ignore|copy|cut|paste|confirm-delete|rename}; outside focus ignore; altKey ignore; Delete needs >=1; F2 exactly 1; Ctrl/Cmd+c/x/v; createFileExplorerShortcutHandler({getContext,run}) preventDefault exactly once only when not ignore.

fileExplorerClipboard.ts exports ExplorerClipboard(re-export from fileRowInteraction), ExplorerSelection{sessionId,paths}, PasteTarget{destSessionId,destPath}, PasteJobRequest{operation copy|move,sourceSessionId,sources,destSessionId,destPath}, DeleteJobRequest{operation delete,sourceSessionId,sources}; get/set/clear/subscribe; copySelection/cutSelection -> ExplorerClipboard|null; buildPasteJobRequest(cb,target)|null (mixed sessions -> null); buildDeleteJobRequest(sel)|null. fileExplorerShortcuts.ts: decideFileExplorerShortcut({event,focusedInSurface,selectionCount}) kinds ignore|copy|cut|paste|confirm-delete|rename; createFileExplorerShortcutHandler({getContext,run}). AC-7 guard still red only because fileExplorerContextMenu.ts missing.

Wiring contract in fileExplorerInteractionWiring.test.ts (read the file). Key points: container onContextMenu in both views via resolveContextMenuTarget (kind none -> preventDefault+return), decideContextMenuSelection -> const -> dispatch before open-menu call; '..' row (data-up) has no data-path/handlers/spread; <ContextMenu items={buildFileExplorerContextMenuItems(...)}> from '../ContextMenu/ContextMenu'; useLongPress from '../../hooks/useLongPress' reaching decideRowPointer; no role=menu, no navigator.vibrate, no setTimeout in touchstart; second arg of buildFileExplorerContextMenuItems has /new ?tab/i key reaching addTab/openInNewTab; clipboard={...} from ./fileExplorerClipboard on both views, rowRenderClass(row, clipboard), exactly one .fx-row.cut CSS rule opacity<1; first child of WindowDialog has onKeyDown running createFileExplorerShortcutHandler with .contains(document.activeElement), no addEventListener('key'); FileExplorerMobileBar.tsx buildMobileActionButtons(...).map one <button> with disabled + fx- class, CSS min-height>=44px, rendered when useResponsive().isMobile; FileExplorerConfirmBar.tsx no portal/dialog stack/WindowDialog/MessageBox, rendered inside WindowDialog children; exactly one <WindowDialog mode=modeless>; useInlineRename from '../../hooks/useInlineRename' with onRename reaching fileApi.moveFile( and startEdit; registerFileJobHandler(...) arg contains applyJobDone(, 'invalidate', sessionId comparison; CLICK_ROW/CLEAR_SELECTION dispatch only inside functions calling decideRowPointer/decideContextMenuSelection.

fileExplorerContextMenu.ts: FILE_EXPLORER_MENU_ORDER=['open','newtab','sep','copy','cut','paste','sep','rename','delete','sep','newdir','refresh']; decideContextMenuSelection(selected,clickedPath|null)->{selectedPaths:Set,targets} no mutation; buildFileExplorerContextMenuItems(info{target item|empty,isDir,openable,count,clipboardEmpty,mode tree|list,context explorer-window|editor-panel}, handlers{open,newtab,copy,cut,paste,rename,delete,newdir,refresh}) -> ContextMenuItem[] filtered from ORDER, {separator:true} no leading/trailing/double; labels 편집기로 열기/새 탭에서 열기/복사/잘라내기/붙여넣기/이름 바꾸기/삭제/새 폴더/새로 읽기; empty -> paste,newdir,refresh; list drops newtab; disabled not hidden: open unless !isDir&&openable, newtab unless isDir&&explorer-window, paste=clipboardEmpty, rename count!==1; shortcuts Ctrl+C/X/V, Delete, F2; buildMobileActionButtons({count,clipboardEmpty},handlers) ids copy,cut,paste,delete,rename,newdir. No viewableExtensions/isViewableExtension/isOpenableFile tokens.
